context: Asuka lectures on a difficult ethical conclusion.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: ethics lecture; vocabulary (受ける/与える/ざる/実践/回答) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 倫理は、実践してこそ意味があります。
lines.en: Ethics has meaning only when practiced.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実践は、難しくないですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 難しいと、認めざるを得ません。
lines.en: I can't help but admit it's difficult.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 迷った時の、回答はありますか?
lines.en: Is there an answer when we hesitate?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 簡単な回答は、与えられません。
lines.en: I can't give an easy answer.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 影響を受ける人を、考えるんですね。
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人に与える影響を、常に考えましょう。
lines.en: Always consider the impact you give others.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実践を、大切にせざるを得ませんね。
lines.en: We can't help but value practice.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
